title: Home · Devices
description: Batteries, radio links and silent sensors.

panels.title: Verisure alarm

targets.rawSql:
(SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, value AS "Value" FROM verisure
 WHERE topic = 'home/verisure/mode' AND time > now() - interval '365 days' AND time < $__timeFrom() ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT time, value FROM verisure WHERE topic = 'home/verisure/mode' AND time > now() - interval '365 days' AND $__timeFilter(time))
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Mode from Verisure's API, looked up on each arm/disarm push. 'Armed' means the push arrived but the mode lookup did not answer.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ble AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id) place AS device, 'SwitchBot (BLE)' AS kind, batt AS battery, time AS seen
  FROM mqtt_consumer JOIN (VALUES ('D7353530665A', 'Living room'), ('D63534385106', 'Office'), ('D83535301C43', 'Upstairs office'), ('C76A05062842', 'Bedroom'), ('D7353530520F', 'Second bedroom'), ('D83431306571', 'Upstairs bathroom'), ('CE2A82463674', 'Downstairs bathroom'), ('D83534387029', 'Front yard'), ('D9353438450D', 'Backyard'), ('D4343037362D', 'Patio'), ('C76A03460A73', 'Storage'), ('C76A0246647E', 'Car'), ('A4C138FD13EF', 'Patio display'), ('C76A0306280B', 'Fridge'), ('D43535302778', 'Freezer'), ('CE2A83062A34', 'Filament dryer'), ('C76A00462055', 'AMS 1'), ('C76A05065C4E', 'AMS 2'), ('CE2A82463295', 'Drybox 1'), ('D9343130222A', 'Drybox 2'), ('CE2A8486490B', 'Drybox 3')) AS n (device_id, place) USING (device_id)
  WHERE time > now() - interval '14 days' AND device_id IN ('D7353530665A', 'D63534385106', 'D83535301C43', 'C76A05062842', 'D7353530520F', 'D83431306571', 'CE2A82463674', 'D83534387029', 'D9353438450D', 'D4343037362D', 'C76A03460A73', 'C76A0246647E', 'A4C138FD13EF', 'C76A0306280B', 'D43535302778', 'CE2A83062A34', 'C76A00462055', 'C76A05065C4E', 'CE2A82463295', 'D9343130222A', 'CE2A8486490B') AND batt IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, time DESC),
zigbee AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id) device_id AS device, 'Zigbee' AS kind, battery, time AS seen
  FROM mqtt_consumer
  WHERE time > now() - interval '14 days' AND integration_id = 'zigbee2mqtt' AND battery IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, time DESC)
SELECT device, kind, battery, seen, extract(epoch FROM now() - seen) / 3600 AS hours
FROM (SELECT * FROM ble UNION ALL SELECT * FROM zigbee) b
ORDER BY battery

  WHERE time > now() - interval '14 days' AND device_id IN ('D7353530665A', 'D63534385106', 'D83535301C43', 'C76A05062842', 'D7353530520F', 'D83431306571', 'CE2A82463674', 'D83534387029', 'D9353438450D', 'D4343037362D', 'C76A03460A73', 'C76A0246647E', 'A4C138FD13EF', 'C76A0306280B', 'D43535302778', 'CE2A83062A34', 'C76A00462055', 'C76A05065C4E', 'CE2A82463295', 'D9343130222A', 'CE2A8486490B') AND batt IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, time DESC),
zigbee AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id) device_id AS device, 'Zigbee' AS kind, battery, time AS seen
  FROM mqtt_consumer
  WHERE time > now() - interval '14 days' AND integration_id = 'zigbee2mqtt' AND battery IS NOT NULL

SELECT device, kind, battery, seen, extract(epoch FROM now() - seen) / 3600 AS hours
FROM (SELECT * FROM ble UNION ALL SELECT * FROM zigbee) b) b WHERE battery < 20

panels.description: Battery devices that reported nothing for a day: dead battery or out of range.

panels.title: Weakest Zigbee links

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_id AS device, avg(linkquality) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE time > now() - interval '1 day' AND integration_id = 'zigbee2mqtt' AND linkquality IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 12

panels.description: Average link quality over the last day (0–255). Under ~40 the device needs a closer router.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('12 hours', time) AS time, place, avg(batt) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer JOIN (VALUES ('D7353530665A', 'Living room'), ('D63534385106', 'Office'), ('D83535301C43', 'Upstairs office'), ('C76A05062842', 'Bedroom'), ('D7353530520F', 'Second bedroom'), ('D83431306571', 'Upstairs bathroom'), ('CE2A82463674', 'Downstairs bathroom'), ('D83534387029', 'Front yard'), ('D9353438450D', 'Backyard'), ('D4343037362D', 'Patio'), ('C76A03460A73', 'Storage'), ('C76A0246647E', 'Car'), ('A4C138FD13EF', 'Patio display'), ('C76A0306280B', 'Fridge'), ('D43535302778', 'Freezer'), ('CE2A83062A34', 'Filament dryer'), ('C76A00462055', 'AMS 1'), ('C76A05065C4E', 'AMS 2'), ('CE2A82463295', 'Drybox 1'), ('D9343130222A', 'Drybox 2'), ('CE2A8486490B', 'Drybox 3')) AS n (device_id, place) USING (device_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN ('D7353530665A', 'D63534385106', 'D83535301C43', 'C76A05062842', 'D7353530520F', 'D83431306571', 'CE2A82463674', 'D83534387029', 'D9353438450D', 'D4343037362D', 'C76A03460A73', 'C76A0246647E', 'A4C138FD13EF', 'C76A0306280B', 'D43535302778', 'CE2A83062A34', 'C76A00462055', 'C76A05065C4E', 'CE2A82463295', 'D9343130222A', 'CE2A8486490B') AND batt IS NOT NULL
